contenu:
name: "$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)"

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: "pipelines"
      type: "git"
      name: "Azure/template-pipelines"

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - dev*
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: "jobs/megalinter.yml@pipelines"
  parameters:
    megalinter_image_name: oxsecurity/megalinter-formatters
    megalinter_configuration:
      - name: DISABLE
        value: SPELL
    publish_to_sonarqube: true

parameters:
- name: azureSubscription
  type: string
- name: pipelineDeploymentEnvironment
  type: string
- name: containerAppName
  type: string
- name: containerAppResourceGroupName
  type: string
- name: migrationContainerAppJobName
  type: string
  default: ''
- name: waitMigrationJob
  type: boolean
  default: true
- name: jobPool
  default: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
- name: failOnStandardError
  default: true

jobs:
- deployment: deploy_container_app_${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  displayName: deploy to ${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  pool: ${{ parameters.jobPool }}
  environment: ${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  workspace:
    clean: all
  strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Configure az cli error output
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
              failOnStandardError: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Deploy Container App 'latest' tag  
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                ca='${{ parameters.containerAppName }}'
                rg='${{ parameters.containerAppResourceGroupName }}'
                
                rev=$(az containerapp show -n $ca -g $rg --query properties.latestRevisionName -o tsv)
                az containerapp revision restart -n $ca -g $rg --revision $rev
              failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}
          
          - ${{ if ne(parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName, '') }}:
            - task: AzureCLI@2
              displayName: Run '${{ parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName }}' Database Migration Job 
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
                scriptType: 'bash'
                scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                inlineScript: |
                  cajob='${{ parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName }}'
                  rg='${{ parameters.containerAppResourceGroupName }}'

                  name=$(az containerapp job start \
                      -n $cajob \
                      -g $rg \
                      --query name -o tsv)

                  echo "Launched container app Job execution '$name'"
 
                  wait=${{ parameters.waitMigrationJob }}

                  if [ "$wait" == "True" ]
                  then
                    jobstatus=$(az containerapp job execution show \
                      -n $cajob \
                      -g $rg \
                      --job-execution-name $name \
                      --query properties.status -o tsv)

                    running_status='Running'
                    unknown_status='Unknown'
                    success_status='Succeeded'

                    while [ "$jobstatus" == "$running_status" ] || [ "$jobstatus" == "$unknown_status" ]; do
                      echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - Running..."
                      sleep 7
                      jobstatus=$(az containerapp job execution show \
                        -n $cajob \
                        -g $rg \
                        --job-execution-name $name \
                        --query properties.status -o tsv)
                    done

                    if [ "$jobstatus" != "$success_status" ]; then
                      echo "Migration Job did not complete successfully, status: $jobstatus"
                      echo "Please check the container app job logs"
                      exit 1
                    fi

                    echo "Migration Job completed successfully !"
                  fi
                  
                failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}

parameters:
- name: folder
  type: string
- name: npmauth
  default: true

jobs:
- job: 'dynamic_tests'
  displayName: 'Dynamic Tests'
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
  steps:
  - template: ../steps/steps-node-install-node.yml
    parameters:
      folder: '${{ parameters.folder }}'

  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: ${{ parameters.folder }}/.npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate Private npm Registry
    condition: ${{ eq(parameters.npmauth, true) }}

  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm install
    displayName: Install npm Dependencies

  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm run build
    displayName: Build Project
  
  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm run test:cov:ci
    displayName: Run Unit Tests
    continueOnError: true
  
  - task: PublishTestResults@2
    inputs:
      testResultsFiles: junit.xml
      mergeTestResults: true
      failTaskOnFailedTests: true
    displayName: Publish Unit Test Results

  - task: PublishCodeCoverageResults@2
    inputs:
      summaryFileLocation: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml'
      failIfCoverageEmpty: true
    displayName: Publish Test Coverage Results

parameters:
- name: folder
  type: string
- name: auditLevel
  type: string
  default: 'Low'
- name: npmauth
  default: true

jobs:
- job: 'static_tests'
  displayName: 'Static Tests'
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
  steps:
  - template: ../steps/steps-node-install-node.yml
    parameters:
      folder: '${{ parameters.folder }}'

  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: ${{ parameters.folder }}/.npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate Private npm Registry
    condition: ${{ eq(parameters.npmauth, true) }}

  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm install
    displayName: Install npm Dependencies

  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm audit --audit-level=${{ parameters.auditLevel }}
    displayName: Check For Vulnerable Dependencies

  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm run lint
    displayName: Lint Typescript Files
    continueOnError: true
  
  - script: |
      cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
      npm run lintSass
    displayName: Lint Style Files
    condition: always()

parameters:
- name: folder
  type: string

steps:
- script: |
    cd ${{ parameters.folder }}
    node_version=$(cat package.json | jq -r '.engines.node')
    echo "Setting Node Version to '$node_version'"
    echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=nodeVersion;isoutput=true]$node_version"
  name: SetNodeVersion
  displayName: Set Node Version from package.json

- task: NodeTool@0
  inputs:
    versionSource: 'spec'
    versionSpec: $(SetNodeVersion.nodeVersion)
  displayName: 'Install Node'
